agent_gate_note: Agents MUST check `retryable` before retrying. Gate on `cli_exit_code` for numeric branching. Use `remediation_command` for self-healing.

codes.description: A required AgentPress bundle or contract file is absent. Bundle is incomplete and cannot be used.
A JSON file failed to parse. The file is corrupt or malformed. Do not use its contents.
SHA256 of a package file does not match the manifest. Treat the package as untrusted; re-fetch from canonical URL.
An attestation signature or hash does not match the referenced artifact. Proof chain is broken.
A remote fetch failed (timeout, DNS error, non-200 response). Use the offline package or raw GitHub fallback.
The requested action requires human maintainer approval before it can proceed. Do not retry autonomously.
Private or secret material was detected in submission payload. Redact before resubmitting.
codes.remediation_command: redact secrets/private data, then rerun proof-ingest or painpoint-intake

codes.description: One item in a batch run failed. Other items may have succeeded. Inspect the JSONL result and rerun only the failed item.
codes.remediation_command: inspect item result and rerun only failed item
